static_coordinate.interpretation: scale-qualified transport of the historical operational proxy; not an exact preprocessing replication and not a physical damping ratio
static_coordinate.ddof_note: with fixed n=5, ddof=0 versus ddof=1 rescales every chi by the same constant and cannot change B-versus-R direction
eligibility: common eligible gene universe across B, R, and G
no additional expression threshold selected after outcome inspection

A_genomewide_primary.clone_summary: median gene-wise chi_GRI over the frozen common eligible genome-wide universe
distributional_descriptives: fraction of eligible genes with chi_B > chi_R
A_genomewide_primary.historical_damping_direction: Delta_A > 0 because source-defined clone B is more persistent/less oscillatory than clone R
A_genomewide_primary.robustness: recompute after leaving out matched biological replicate index 1..5 from all clones; direction is robust only if all five leave-one-out Delta_A values have the same sign as the full estimate

B_circuit_sensitivity.source_basis: explicit TNF receptor, NF-kB p65, IkBa feedback, and A20 feedback species in the source TNF/NF-kB model
B_circuit_sensitivity.clone_summary: median of the four frozen gene-wise chi_GRI values
B_circuit_sensitivity.robustness: same five matched leave-one-biological-replicate-out calculations; robust only if all five signs match the full estimate

native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.orientation: rows are 6-minute time points; columns are single cells; no header
native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.peak_detection: local peaks after smoothing with prominence > 0.15, matching the published method
native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.primary_endpoint: fraction of cells with >=2 peaks in the first approximately 4 hours
native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.secondary_endpoint: cell-level AUC over available 6-minute samples; median_AUC_B > median_AUC_R
native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.gate: if the primary R>B oscillatory ordering is not reproduced in Fig2, stop chi interpretation and classify a native dynamic reproduction failure; Fig1 is a prespecified robustness check
native_dynamic_reproduction_gate.G_role: weak-activation limit/control case; no damping-order prediction is imposed

D_joint_interpretation.three_clone_descriptive_only: Spearman/Kendall ordering against observed oscillatory fraction may be reported descriptively with all six label permutations, but n=3 cannot be treated as independent confirmatory evidence

failure_and_claim_ceiling.no_pseudoreplication: genes and cells are not independent biological-system replicates; no gene-level or cell-level p-value may be presented as validation of the cross-layer hypothesis
failure_and_claim_ceiling.opposite_direction: contradicts the historical damping-like relational prediction; do not retune
failure_and_claim_ceiling.allowed_positive_claim: pre-stimulus historical RNA fluctuation proxy shows exploratory directional correspondence with later NF-kB oscillatory/persistent behavior in this source
forbidden_claims: chi_GRI is a physical damping ratio
